document_notes: Entries 1070 (M. Arranius Venustus) and 1072 (M. Arrecinus Clemens) are relevant to the PROVINCIA corpus due to explicit or restored governorship formulas.

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly identified as 'legatus Aug. pr. pr. (exercitus Africani)'.

segments.identification_and_sources: memoratur in t. filii M. Arranii Venusti Bassiliani clarissimi pueri Ammaedarensi Bull. tr. hist. 1927, 199 = Ann. ép. 1927, 37.
segments.offices_and_career: legatus Aug. pr. pr. (exercitus Africani), consul designatus a. 166 VIII 4195 t. Verecundae rep.
segments.family_and_social_relations: Father of M. Arranius Venustus Bassilianus (1071).
segments.prosopographical_commentary: Nescio an idem sit ..... us Venustus, legatus Aug. pr. pr. (exercitus Africani), consul designatus a. 166.
segments.bibliography_or_cross_references: Bull. tr. hist. 1927, 199 = Ann. ép. 1927, 37; VIII 4195.

notes: The command of the exercitus Africanus (Numidia) was equivalent to a legatus Augusti pro praetore governorship.

entry_notes: The identification of the legatus with the father of Bassilianus is proposed with 'Nescio an idem sit'.

entries.relevance_notes: Restored as '[legatus Aug. p]ro praet. provinc. [Hispani]ae c[iter]ioris' by Gatti from the inscription fragment t. 4.

segments.name_variants: [M.] Ar[reci]no [Clemente], M. Arricinus Clemens, [M. Arr]ecinus M. f. Cam. [Clemens]
segments.identification_and_sources: consul I suff. a. 73 ut videtur, II suff. a. inc., memoratur in t. urbano VI 199 = D. 6050 (1), in fistulis urbanis XV 7278 (2), in fistula Ariminensi XI 428 (3); ad eum pertinere videtur fragmentum t. Pisaurensis adhue quod sciam ineditum (4).
segments.offices_and_career: praetor urbanus t. 4; praetorianis praepositus a. 70; praefectus praetorio a. 71; consul I suffectus a. 73; consul II suffectus sub Domitiano; [legatus Aug. p]ro praet. provinc. [Hispani]ae c[iter]ioris.
segments.governorship_attestation: In t. 4 praeterea cernitur .....ro praet. provinc..... ae c...[r]ioris, quae verba, recte ut videtur Gatti restituit [legatus Aug. p]ro praet. provinc. [Hispani]ae c[iter]ioris.
segments.family_and_social_relations: Son of M. Arrecinus Clemens (praefectus praetorio under Caligula). Brother of Arrecina Tertulla, who married Titus. Domui Vespasiani per adfinitatem innexus.
segments.prosopographical_commentary: Nominatur in fistulis aquariis Imp. Domitiani Caes. Aug. factis sub cura M. Arricini Clementis t. 2; num unus ex adiutoribus fuerit curatoris aquarum... Gratissimus Domitiano... A Domitiano capitis damnatus.

notes: Restored by Gatti from '.....ro praet. provinc..... ae c...[r]ioris' in inscription t. 4.

related_persons.relation_context: father, praefectus praetorio sub Gaio Caesare

relations.basis: M. Arrecini Clementis praefecti praetorio sub Gaio Caesare filius
Arrecinam Tertullam sororem, quae nupserat Tito Vespasiani filio

entry_notes: Arrecinus Clemens was closely connected to the Flavian dynasty, but was eventually executed by Domitian.
